answer: Proposal: one-claim nullifier credentials in a walled garden registry. A trusted issuer verifies each registrant's uniqueness (ID check, dedupe, revocation) and each credential redeems exactly one reward per epoch via a zero-knowledge nullifier; the contract rejects reuse, so any fleet of alias agent keys split from one credential reaches the same summit: a single claim at the oasis. Extra claims require extra credentials — forged uniqueness proofs or bought registrants — a linear cost set by issuer fraud checks and revocation risk, offset against per-claim reward.
